prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 团队周报看板（第 34 周） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "成员" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 53px
  col 2: header "状态" · longest unbreakable word 21px · one-line width 61px
  col 3: header "本周完成" · longest unbreakable word 64px · one-line width 768px
  col 4: header "下周计划" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 1057px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 437px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 436px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按成员汇总第 34 周的工作状态、本周完成情况和下周计划，帮助团队识别进展、风险与阻塞。","reading":"读者先按行找到成员和状态，再横向阅读完成情况与计划；也会纵向扫描状态，比较不同成员的进展。长文本将决定行高，较短单元格可在同一行内留白。","groups":["「成员」与「状态」共同构成每行的身份和状态索引，应便于快速扫描。","「本周完成」与「下周计划」分别描述过去与未来的工作，角色相近，需要保留足够空间供连续阅读和比较。"],"keep_intact":["成员姓名","状态图标与文字","数字、英文缩写及其他不可断开的标识"],"may_wrap":["本周完成的中文叙述可自然换行。","下周计划的中文叙述可自然换行；较短的完成情况可利用计划产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [74, 82, 125, 155] · table 437×1409px · row heights [39, 250, 224, 250, 224, 224, 197] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [74, 81, 135, 146] · table 437×1409px · row heights [39, 250, 250, 250, 197, 224, 197] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [74, 82, 140, 140] · table 437×1567px · row heights [39, 276, 276, 303, 197, 250, 224] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"成员姓名和状态图标及文字均保持完整，索引列易于纵向扫描；计划列较宽，照顾了更长的内容，表头也完整。","problems":"本周完成列显得狭窄，若干短语被切成零碎的行；计划较长的行仍有较多换行，成员和状态列因此出现大片留白。","cause":"完成列为125px，扣除边距和边框后仅104px；计划列155px虽得到更多空间，但仍不足以避免长计划占据多行。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"完成列比r2A更从容，尤其是吴桐一行更紧凑；姓名、状态和表头保持完整，总高度与r2A相同。","problems":"计划列更窄，林思远的计划多占一行，部分词组跨行，削弱了两列叙述的阅读节奏；多行仍由计划列决定高度。","cause":"完成列增至135px的同时，计划列缩至146px；宽度从更长的计划内容转移到了相对较短的完成内容。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"两列叙述宽度相同，视觉上整齐；姓名、状态和表头均完整。","problems":"计划列明显拥挤，前三位成员的计划形成很长的文字块，最长达11行；表格明显变高，短索引列和部分完成单元格的留白也随之扩大。","cause":"两列各140px，但计划内容整体更长；等宽使计划列只有119px的文本空间，无法匹配两列不同的内容量。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"plan-plus","widths":[74,82,119,161],"change":"以r2A为基础，将6px从完成列移给更长的计划列，检验计划行数能否下降，同时观察完成列是否变得过窄。"},{"name":"balanced-refine","widths":[74,82,130,150],"change":"取r2A与r2B之间的分配，让完成列稍宽，同时保留计划列的宽度优势，寻求两列换行与行高的较好平衡。"},{"name":"compact-index","widths":[73,82,125,156],"change":"将成员列压至恰好容纳53px单行内容及21px边距和边框附近，尝试把空间让给计划列；需检查实际姓名是否仍完整。"}]}
